title: Lime Crusted Fish
description: Delicious fish coated with a zesty lime crust, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Mix together the lime zest and crunchy breadcrumbs in a shallow dish.
Dip each cod fillet into the breadcrumb mixture, coating evenly.
Place the coated cod fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the lime juice over the top of the cod fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
